summary: Regression-only verification of the SEO-1.1.1 build-pipeline hotfix on the preview (dev) web server. Confirmed all 5 target public routes load and render without runtime regression: / (home), /about, /pricing, /chsp, /ai-tools/invoice-checker. Each returned HTTP 200, rendered body content, produced ZERO console errors and ZERO page errors, and post-hydration DOM contained exactly ONE of each of the 8 SEO head tags (title, meta description, canonical, og:title, og:description, og:url, twitter:title, twitter:description) — confirming react-helmet-async still emits per-page head tags at runtime and the SeoHead/helmet integration has not regressed. This matches the expectation for the dev preview (which does not run the prerender step); the build-pipeline fix cannot be reproduced/verified in preview and requires the deployed prerendered build to observe the actual duplicate-head fix. No files edited, no yarn build attempted (per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration was a REGRESSION-ONLY smoke test for a build-pipeline SEO hotfix. The changed scripts (prerender-lib.mjs, seo-verify.mjs) only run during yarn build/deploy — they do NOT execute in the dev preview server, so the duplicate-head bug cannot be reproduced in preview. Runtime validation confirmed helmet still emits exactly one of each of the 8 SEO tags on all 5 target routes. To fully validate the fix, a build-time smoke test (running yarn build and inspecting the emitted /build/**/index.html) is required, but was explicitly out-of-scope for this run.
rca of the issue: N/A — no runtime issues observed. Build-time RCA already documented by main agent E1 in the review request.
